text: A stadium clapping together is thunder. Random claps mostly cancel. The paper averages particle spins like a crowd forced onto one beat. A species simply means one kind of particle. It groups six neutrino species, six kinds of nearly weightless particle, like six stadium sections clapping in step. If they act independently, the torsion estimate is exactly six times smaller, like cutting the same song to one sixth volume. Those choices make the two labeled edges on screen. The printed value sits near the lined up edge, so we carry both. What if a later correction changed the print?
